about.title: About Statsify
about.whatText: The largest Hypixel stats bot on Discord, now on the web.
about.linksText: Click a stat, like <chip/>, to see where the player ranks. The <glossary>Stat Glossary</glossary> explains what each one means.
about.linksTextTouch: Tap a stat, like <chip/>, to see where the player ranks. The <glossary>Stat Glossary</glossary> explains what each one means.
about.statsText: Stats come from Hypixel's API and update each time someone looks a player up.
about.leaderboardsNote: Leaderboards rank players who've been looked up on Statsify, not all of Hypixel.
about.namesText: Names and skins come from Mojang and update upon search.
about.sourceText: Statsify is open source. See the code on <github>GitHub</github>.

glossary.title: Stat Glossary
glossary.intro: What each stat on Statsify means, how the ratios are worked out, and which games show it. The labels are the ones on the bot's cards.
glossary.levels: BedWars levels and their colors are on the <prestiges>BedWars Prestiges</prestiges> page.
glossary.noMatches: No stats match "{{query}}". Try fewer letters, or clear the box.
glossary.ratiosNote: Ratios are rounded to two decimal places. With nothing to divide by, a ratio equals the top number.

prestiges.title: BedWars Prestiges
prestiges.intro: Every BedWars prestige up to {{top}} stars. Each is 100 levels and {{exp}} EXP.
